packageRules.description: Patch and minor updates to the four runtime dependencies this ecosystem actually has, batched into one PR. express, cors and dotenv are the entire runtime surface of 33 services; a separate PR per app would be 33 PRs for one version bump.

Node itself is pinned in two Dockerfiles, CI, and every engines field, and scripts/test/node-version.test.mjs holds all four to the same major. A Renovate bump that moved one would fail that test rather than drift silently -- which is the intended behaviour, so it stays a PR a human reads.

The LiveKit server image carries the media plane. A major here can change the token claim shape that vaco-media/lib/transport/livekit.js signs, and that adapter deliberately has no SDK to warn it -- so majors are never grouped away where they are easy to miss.
Security fixes should not wait for Monday.
